summary: Mostly no. VO(5,10) crossing up through 0 did no better than random candles on 1h, 4h or daily, and the volume-spike cross up through 20 was fragile on all three. The result that holds up is a warning for longs: after VO crossed down through 0 on 4h, price did worse than after random candles at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles.

verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h, 4h or daily, in uptrends and downtrends on 1h and 4h.

On 4h, price did 0.24% worse than after random candles 20 candles later, and the gap shows at 10, 50 and 100 candles too. Split by trend, it is fragile in uptrends and inside the luck band in downtrends.

On 1h, price was 0.07% ahead of random candles after 20 candles, and on 4h it was inside the luck band. These candles are volatile and the window rose, so this is price moving more after them, not a pick of direction.

On 4h, price rose 0.69% more than after random candles, and uptrends carry it (0.92%). In downtrends it was inside the luck band, and it fires in volatile candles, so read it as larger moves in a rising window.
Above the luck band on 1h, 4h and daily, but each result shows at 20 candles only or vanishes without a handful of entries.

notes: VO(5,10) crossing up through 0 landed inside the luck band on every timeframe. It was 0.01% ahead of random after 20 candles on 1h and 4h, and 0.66% behind on daily. Crossing down through 0 fires about as often on 1h, so the cross itself marks no turn on these pairs.

Crossing down through 0 on 4h gave 4,189 entries in 344 separate moves. Twenty candles later price was 0.24% behind random entries, below a band of -0.17% to 0.19%. That holds without its strongest stretch, between May 17 and Jul 1, 2022, and at 10, 50 and 100 candles. In uptrends it was fragile, and in downtrends it was inside the band, so neither regime carries it alone. On daily it was 1.57% behind and fragile overall, but in downtrends it fell 2.74% behind, at every horizon and without its strongest stretch. In uptrends the daily result showed nothing.

Holding while VO(5,10) was above 0 on 1h gave 64,338 entries in 391 moves, 0.07% ahead of random after 20 candles. It holds without the stretch between Feb 12 and Mar 28, 2021 and at 50 and 100 candles, though not at 10. On BTC it was inside the band. Split by trend it is fragile in both regimes: in uptrends it vanishes without the stretch between Aug 22 and Oct 8, 2021, and in downtrends it shows at 20 candles only. VO above 0 fires mostly in volatile candles, and the window rose, so this is price moving more after those candles, not a directional edge.

VO above 20 on 4h was 0.69% ahead of random, holding without its strongest stretch, on Jan 2–4, 2021, and at 10 and 50 candles. Uptrends carry it at 0.92%; in downtrends it was 0.35% ahead, inside the band. By coin, only BTC cleared the band, and only as fragile. On 1h the same setting was fragile overall, with an uptrend result of 0.22% and nothing in downtrends. It fires in volatile candles too, so read these as larger moves in a rising window, not as direction.

The cross up through 20 looks good on paper and falls apart under the checks. On 1h it rests on 5 entries on Aug 15–16, 2021. On daily it was 4.69% ahead but vanishes without 3 entries between Dec 28, 2022 and Jan 14, 2023. On 4h it shows at 20 candles only. These are volatile candles in a rising window, so none of this is a directional result.

For a long bot, the clearest use is as a reason to leave a setting out. A 4h start condition that fires as VO crosses down through 0 opened into weaker moves, and on daily that showed in downtrends. VO above 20 on 4h can sit beside your own entry condition as an uptrend filter, but it marks bigger swings, not direction. Set the DCA step and take profit for those larger moves. The crosses through 0 add nothing to timing on their own.
